title: Horizon Peaks SMP
description: Horizon Peaks is a community-driven Minecraft network featuring a vanilla-style SMP, Creative mode, and a live world map.
body:
We built **Horizon Peaks SMP** because we wanted a forever server.
No seasonal resets, no map wipes, no starting over.
Your builds stay.

The server runs pure vanilla mechanics — we use Fabric so nothing changes about how the game plays.
No Paper, no Spigot, no plugins that mess with redstone or mob behavior.

A tight community of people who actually care about their world. We keep it small on purpose.
Everyone knows each other and people help out. That's the way we like it.

Currently Java Edition only. We might open up to Bedrock in the future if there's enough interest, but no promises.
